# Scramble

Used in [Air Game — fighters](/rules/air/50-fighters).

## Table

| Distance | Scramble |
|---|---|
| 0–2 | 6 |
| 3–4 | 5 |
| 5–6 | 4 |
| 7–8 | 3 |
| 9–10 | 2 |
| 11–15 | 1 |

## Notes

- Scramble Table, 40.4, chart page 11 (jp2 105). Read twice, from the archive.org scan and the community chart PDFs (Shared Charts.pdf p. 11): 0 of 12 cells differ.
- distance is in hexes from the scrambling squadron's base to the target hex; one die per squadron, at or under scramble succeeds. Beyond 15 hexes no scramble is possible. Night fighters scrambling against a night bombing mission add 2 to the die (40.91).
